decisionReason: Earliest failure attribution is definitively established as Category 4 (missing/inaccurate edit anchor). Structured proposal decoding (V1.8) eliminated parse failures, but qwen2.5-coder:3b cannot reliably emit verbatim character matches for searchAnchor. No installed model provides superior coding capability within host memory constraints (7.63 GB total, 1.30 GB free). Weakening anchor invariants is forbidden by capability fencing and security policy. Therefore, no code change is causally justified.
